purpose: Research governance for a persistent, model-independent AI companion. Paid DeepSeek research is authorized only through the capped research gateway; no autonomous paid loop or private-data upload.

dynamic_capacity.note: V1 closeout: 4 research lanes + 1 milestone auditor. Existing excess ACTIVE leases may finish a bounded pass, but new joins are denied until occupancy contracts.

paid_research.comparison_note: Controlled self-hosted track uses non-thinking DeepSeek Flash unless a separately frozen experiment changes this for all compared backends.
paid_research.budget_note: Owner rule 2026-11-01: any prospectively frozen paid research scope with conservative peak hard cap <10 CNY is cost-authorized by default; >=10 CNY requires explicit owner approval. Scientific/data gates and the 100 CNY project ceiling remain fail-closed.

runtime_guard.note: Lead cost/governance guard: registered proxy tags only when require_proxy_tag=true; direct ResearchApiBudget calls fail before reservation/provider. Internal XiaoYu experiments use local-budget-proxy:xiaoyu. Per-scope 15-minute and epoch circuit breakers remain unchanged.
runtime_guard.benchmark_peak_policy_note: Owner rule 2026-10-30: weekday Beijing peak hours block only scopes whose conservative epoch hard-cap cost exceeds 10 CNY. Small bounded scopes <=10 CNY may execute in peak hours; formal/large scopes remain blocked.

pricing_cny_per_million.note: Weekday Beijing peak 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 excluding Chinese public holidays; off-peak is half price.

benchmark_unlock.note: This unlock authorizes only paid execution under the frozen prospective protocol; it is not an E2/E3 scientific or product claim.

paid_research.budget_snapshot_note: DeepSeek spend snapshot remains pre-V7; V7 adds at most 0.172 CNY conservative peak bound. Formal confirmatory remains false.

allocation_guard.rule: 100 CNY is a hard ceiling, not a target. Stage expansion requires completed prior gate and fresh cost projection.

paid_research.budget_mode_compat_note: Authoritative owner policy is BUDGET100_AUTO_SCOPE_LT10_CNY; older frozen scopes may retain historical budget-mode strings only inside their immutable evidence.

risk_tiers.E1: reproducible lead-ready candidate; review is NOT scientific proof
risk_tiers.E2: frozen prospective protocol plus independent formal audit; future gate, NOT implemented
risk_tiers.E3: user-facing promotion requiring E2 plus blind and privacy acceptance; future gate, NOT implemented

audit_materiality.P0: Observed privacy/security/identity integrity failure; blocks only this candidate.
audit_materiality.P1: Observed invalid scientific evidence or meaningful regression; blocks only this candidate.
audit_materiality.P2: Risk, incomplete noncritical coverage or improvement proposal; advisory, never E1 blocker.
audit_materiality.P3: Cosmetic, naming, code style or minor preference; advisory, never E1 blocker.
audit_materiality.safety_boundary: True user-facing production changes remain disabled; this E1 policy does not authorize them.

reuse_guard.note: Build-vs-Reuse V2: component lifecycle/health metadata, concrete dependencies, prior-work review, catalog revision binding and local doctor. Existing v1 lease decisions remain valid for their current lease.

authority.required_gate: R17 trusted authority + R21 poisoning/laundering lifecycle

erasure_freshness.later_tombstone_behavior: next exposure fails closed until reconciliation

paid_evidence_promotion.note: E0 evidence may remain observational. LEAD_READY paid-model claims after proxy-only epoch must bind exact api-* IDs to committed proxy usage.
paid_evidence_promotion.containment_note: Future paid LEAD_READY fails closed until the verifier binds a trust-boundary-generated provider/proxy attestation unavailable to research workers. This does not block ordinary paid E0/EVIDENCE_ONLY execution and does not invalidate current ACCEPT_E1.

phase_priority_guard.note: Fail closed on new self-directed research while an unclaimed active backlog task in the current auto-assign phase exists. Backlog-bound claims, exact recovery and auditors are exempt.

continuous_research_exception.note: V1 closeout disables open-ended self-directed research. All new research is backlog-bound to a release gate; one emergency divergent slot requires explicit Lead routing.
continuous_research_exception.capacity_note: This is only a safety allowance. Authoritative admission capacity is startup.dynamic_capacity and contracts/expands dynamically.

representation_boundary.canonical_current: final effective grounded SET/CLEAR per slot after deterministic canonicalization
representation_boundary.cross_message_history: typed projections ordered by trusted effective_at

e2_transition.cache_target_revision_reason: Post-first-real-batch evidence shows LongMemEval's 158-token common prefix is structurally below a reusable V4.1 128-token block after SWA backoff; do not mutate the frozen pilot prompt to chase cache hit rate.
e2_transition.confirmatory_paid_gateway_rule: PREFREEZE hard-deny; after READY_FOR_CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE, exact runner/manifest/gateway hashes + frozen UUID stream membership + exact v5 prefix + durable duplicate ledger are required.

governance_slimming.exception: Only when an observed P0/P1 cannot be expressed or prevented by the existing control plane.

productization_policy.research_to_product_rule: Each material ACCEPT_E1 capability must be integrated, explicitly deferred with a product reason, or retired; ACCEPT_E1 accumulation alone is not progress.

dual_track_operating_model.promotion_rule: Research stays advisory until accepted by existing product/audit gates; product failures, longitudinal drift, cross-model drift, provenance failures, scale/performance regressions and new falsifiers reopen research.

worker_instance_guard.id_format: 8-96 letters/digits/_/-; generate once per ChatGPT worker chat
worker_instance_guard.rule: Every lease claimed after effective_after_epoch is bound to one per-chat worker_instance_id. Parallel chats reusing the same agent_id cannot resume each other's ACTIVE workspace.

current_capability_sprint.preemption: Only observed material P0/P1 product-safety, authority-integrity or scientific-validity incidents may preempt.
